ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Download Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*urlcache\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*verifyctl\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*"))
